overview.value: Multinational technology enterprise focusing on e-commerce, cloud computing with Amazon Web Services, digital streaming, and artificial intelligence solutions.

value.name: Customer Obsession
value.description: Leaders start with the customer and work backwards, earning and keeping trust.

value.name: Ownership
value.description: Leaders act on behalf of the entire company, never saying 'that's not my job'.

value.name: Invent and Simplify
value.description: Leaders require innovation from their teams and always find ways to simplify systems.

value.name: Bias for Action
value.description: Speed matters in business; many decisions are reversible and do not need extensive study.

value.name: Earn Trust
value.description: Leaders listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

value.name: Deliver Results
value.description: Leaders focus on key business inputs and deliver them with high quality despite setbacks.

value: Online assessment (debugging, coding, or work simulation)
Phone or video technical screening with behavioral Leadership Principle questions
Onsite loop (typically 4-5 rounds, each evaluating 2 Leadership Principles with STAR format)
Dedicated Bar Raiser round focusing on cultural standards and long-term hiring bar
Narrative 6-page memos and silent reading meetings instead of slide decks
Two-pizza teams owning services end-to-end (devops and on-call operational excellence)
Strict STAR method (Situation, Task, Action, Result) expectation in all behavioral evaluations
